title: Preventing Model Extraction in Contextual Linear Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consider a contextual linear optimization problem, where a predict-then-optimize (PTO) system returns optimal decisions without revealing the cost vectors used in its downstream linear program. Our focus is on how to prevent attackers, who can submit context queries, from extracting the underlying prediction model. Although the cost-to-decision map is many-to-one, observations across contexts can reveal the underlying prediction model. For linear models, we provide sufficient conditions where the attacker can learn the model up to positive scaling by only observing the decision. These conditions motivate an adaptive attack that alternates inverse optimization with boundary sampling, i.e., using context queries leading to decision boundaries of the current attacker model. To prevent extraction, we propose a mechanism that perturbs decisions only when the predicted cost vector is near a decision boundary. We establish a regret bound in ter

translated_title: 防止上下文线性优化中的模型提取
translated_abstract: 考虑一个上下文线性优化问题，其中预测后优化（predict-then-optimize, PTO）系统返回最优决策，但不透露其下游线性规划中所使用的成本向量。我们的关注点在于如何防止能够提交上下文查询的攻击者提取底层预测模型。尽管从成本到决策的映射是多对一的，但跨不同上下文的观察仍可能揭示底层预测模型。对于线性模型，我们给出了攻击者仅通过观察决策就能学习到该模型（至多相差一个正的缩放因子）的充分条件。这些条件启发了一种自适应攻击方法，该方法交替使用逆优化与边界采样，即利用导致当前攻击者模型决策边界的上下文查询。为防止模型提取，我们提出了一种机制，仅当预测的成本向量接近某个决策边界时才对决策进行扰动。我们建立了遗憾界……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对预测后优化（PTO）系统研究了模型提取攻击与防御，刻画了线性模型可被攻击者通过决策观察提取的条件，并提出了一种仅在预测成本向量接近决策边界时才扰动决策的防御机制，以在抵御提取攻击的同时控制决策遗憾。
